name: US–China / Taiwan
value: No blockade or clash; Shenzhen talks 19 Nov
summary: US tightened AI chip access for Chinese firms on 16 Nov; Trump and Xi meet at APEC in Shenzhen on 19 Nov
state: The US announced restrictions on 16 Nov limiting Chinese companies' use of advanced chips through data centres abroad, days before Trump meets Xi and Putin in Shenzhen on 19 Nov (Deseret News). Taiwan is expected to take a back seat at the talks (Political.org, 16 Nov). No blockade, military clash or severed channel was found as of 19 Nov; Watch holds on new export controls and continuing PLA activity.
for_you: Tension over chips and trade can affect electronics supply and prices. No change to travel advice was found.
rubric_hit: Major new export controls announced 16 Nov = Watch; no blockade or clash

sources.title: Deseret News — Trump, Xi and Putin set to meet on the sidelines of APEC
Political.org — Taiwan likely to take a backseat as Trump and Xi prepare for third meeting

why: The world's two largest economies; a Taiwan crisis would halt most advanced chip supply and risk great-power war.
drivers: PLA exercises, tariffs and tech controls, diplomacy, Taiwan politics, South China Sea incidents.

rubric.alert: Blockade or 'quarantine' of Taiwan, military clash, or severed diplomatic channels.
rubric.watch: Large-scale PLA exercises around Taiwan, major new sanctions/controls, or a naval/air incident.
rubric.normal: Managed relations; dialogue channels open; routine PLA activity.
